headline: Redevelopment plan for former Steeplegate mall and Regal Cinemas sites approved with conditions.
summary: The meeting covered a comprehensive development plan for a mixed-use redevelopment of the former Steeplegate mall and Regal Cinemas sites. The plan was approved unanimously with conditions, and a city and state traffic review must be resolved before final approval. Members also accepted a Public Safety Advisory Board report and named members to a master plan subcommittee.
decisions: Approved the comprehensive development plan for 282 Loudon Road and nearby lots, with conditions, by unanimous vote.
Accepted the Public Safety Advisory Board report as submitted; the motion carried.
Approved the slate of planning board members and primary and alternate representatives for the master plan subcommittee; the motion carried.
Nominated Noah Hodgetts, Elizabeth Inman, and Chris Carla as public members of the master plan subcommittee; the motion carried.
discussion: Traffic review and off-site improvements: Staff said the city and state traffic review is still ongoing, so the plan must return for a compliance hearing once it is resolved.
Consistency of pending applications: Members asked how three related applications that do not match the plan would be reconciled, and the applicant said they could be adjusted or the plan amended.
Public safety report: Members asked whether the master plan would cover the report's detailed requests, and staff said it would take a higher-level look.
Master plan public engagement: Members discussed a youth-focused event, which they supported, and how to schedule six neighborhood meetings, including Friday and Saturday options.
